question: The constitution of India was adopted by the Constituent Assembly in the year __________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1949**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Constituent Assembly of India was formed in 1**946 to draft a constitution for the country.**
 
• The assembly took almost three years to finalize the Constitution of India, and it was finally adopted on 26th November 1949.
 
• However, the Constitution came into effect on 26th January 1950, which is celebrated as Republic Day in India.
